```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
game_id <- 401856883
# The game's kickoff date from the games table (plays carry no date).
game_date <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT startDate FROM games WHERE id = ?",
  params = list(as.integer(game_id))
)$startDate |>
  substr(1, 10) |>
  as.Date() |>
  format("%B %d, %Y")
teams <- collect(tbl(con, "teams"))
```

```{r}
#| label: sources
# Each player involvement carries where it came from: the play-stats log, the
# play text, or both. The play text adds the tacklers the log leaves out.
plays <- game_plays(con, game_id)
home <- plays$home[1]
away <- plays$away[1]
team_levels <- c(home, away)
matchup <- paste0(home, " vs ", away, ", ", game_date)
season <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  paste0(
    "SELECT gameId, driveId, driveNumber, playNumber, period, offense, ",
    "defense, home, away, offenseScore, defenseScore, yardline, yardsToGoal, ",
    "down, distance, yardsGained, playType, playText, ppa ",
    "FROM plays WHERE season = 2026"
  )
)
fit <- game_ep_fit(season)
epa <- game_epa_model(game_scrimmage(plays), fit)
rated <- dplyr::filter(epa, !is.na(ppa))
inv <- game_involvement(con, game_id, 2026, rated, c(home, away))
involvement <- inv$involvement
sources <- involvement |>
  summarise(
    involvements = n(),
    players = n_distinct(playerId),
    .by = c(source, side)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(
  sources,
  aes(side, involvements, fill = source)
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        side,
        ", ",
        source,
        "</b><br>",
        involvements,
        " involvements by ",
        players,
        " players"
      ),
      data_id = paste(side, source)
    ),
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Play-stats log" = "#d1d5db", "Play text" = "#374151"),
    name = "Named by"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Involvements by side and source",
    subtitle = paste0(
      matchup,
      "; player involvements on each side, by where the name came from"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Player involvements",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "game-player-attribution-sources", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: players
# Per player: involvements named by the log and by the text, for the dot plot.
# Georgia first in the team legend.
by_player <- involvement |>
  summarise(
    log = sum(source == "Play-stats log"),
    text = sum(source == "Play text"),
    team = first(team),
    .by = c(playerId, player)
  ) |>
  mutate(team = factor(team, team_levels))
p_players <- ggplot(by_player, aes(log, text, color = team)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "22") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>",
        player,
        "</b> (",
        team,
        ")<br>",
        log,
        " named by the log, ",
        text,
        " by the play text"
      ),
      data_id = playerId
    ),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_color_team(teams, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Each player's involvements, by source",
    subtitle = paste0(
      matchup,
      "; each dot is one player, placed by how often each source named them"
    ),
    x = "Named by the play-stats log",
    y = "Named by the play text",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card(base_size = 16)
card_interactive(p_players, width_svg = 10, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
sources |>
  arrange(side, source) |>
  transmute(
    Side = side,
    Source = source,
    Involvements = involvements,
    Players = players
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Side", "Named by", "Involvements", "Players"),
    caption = paste0(
      "Where each of the ",
      nrow(involvement),
      " player involvements comes from, over the scrimmage plays with an EPA. ",
      inv$unresolved,
      " text mentions matched no roster player and are left out."
    )
  )
```

DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
